english.note: Use this for someone with a muscular, well-built physique rather than for general physical activity.
Use this when you want to describe a sturdily built physique in a more polished or descriptive way.
Choose this when you specifically mean a muscular, athletic physique, especially in a descriptive or slightly formal context.

examples.english: He has an athletic, muscular build.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 san1 jing4 hou2 gin6 sek6

examples.english: That actor has a strapping build and looks especially good in a suit.
